text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: We are observing an increasing number of 502/504s and slow connects on hosted API frontends in us-west2. Early indicators point to connection exhaustion on edge-proxy workers (keepalive socket leak). Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2115009876-edge-proxy-socket-leak

rachel-sre: Symptom summary: gradual growth in TIME_WAIT and CLOSE_WAIT sockets on frontend hosts leading to accept failures. Error rate up ~3x for affected frontends and tail latencies spiking. No evidence of malicious traffic.

kevin-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: recent keepalive change (reduce idle timeout + deferred close optimization) introduced a path where sockets aren't closed under certain upstream resets. Reproduced locally with high-concurrency simulation.

nina-network: Network note: SYN backlog looks healthy; kernel ephemeral port exhaustion not the blocker. This is application-level FD leak on the proxy process.

kevin-runtime: Mitigation plan in progress:
- rolling restart of edge-proxy workers in us-west2 starting now (canary host us-west2-frontend-03)
- reverting keepalive optimization flag on proxy to previous behavior
- temporarily reduce max-keepalive-per-worker to force faster recycling
Estimated full restoration: 40-60 minutes if roll goes well. Patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/edge-proxy/pulls/493

rachel-sre: Actions executed so far:
- 2115009970: triggered canary restart on us-west2-frontend-03
- 2115010065: observed drop in CLOSE_WAIT on canary and 50% reduction in 502s for canary traffic
- 2115010200: rolling restart to remaining frontends in 3 waves

nanya-support: Draft customer message pinned in #support-ops: "We are experiencing intermittent failures and slow connections for some hosted API requests in us-west2 due to an internal proxy issue. We are rolling restarts and expect recovery within the hour. We will post updates to the status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2115009876-edge-proxy-socket-leak" Please review.

ops-automation-bot: Runbook step "proxy-fd-leak" executed and pagers notified. Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/proxy-keepalive-leak

kevin-runtime: Quick diagnostic for eng-runtime to identify leaked sockets on a host:
```
sudo ss -tanp state CLOSE-WAIT | awk '{print $6}' | wc -l
ps aux | grep edge-proxy | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -I{} sudo lsof -p {} | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
```
If you see persistent CLOSE-WAIT counts >200 on a single worker, escalate to on-call.

rachel-sre: Timeline so far:
- 2115009000: keepalive change rolled out to edge-proxy fleet
- 2115009500: first synthetic alerts for slow connect in us-west2
- 2115009876: incident created
- 2115009970: canary restart initiated
- 2115010065: canary shows improvement

nanya-support: Support guidance (copy/paste):
"Thanks 3 we are aware of intermittent connection failures in us-west2 and have initiated targeted restarts. If you experience persistent failures, please include request-id and approximate time. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2115009876-edge-proxy-socket-leak"

kevin-runtime: Next steps: complete rolling restarts, monitor FD metrics, deploy fix to prevent leak (target patch in next 3 hours). Postmortem to follow with root cause and long-term remediation (instrumentation + e2e test).

rachel-sre: Current status: partial mitigation rolling; canary success. Expect majority of traffic to be normal after wave 2. Next update in 20 minutes or on significant change.

incidents-bot: Update posted to status page. Automated reminder scheduled in 20 minutes. :rotating_light:
